A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Before you start.

Is this a real store?

This is a practice storefront. Prices are examples. Checkout is simulated, no money is charged, and no actual Notion template is delivered.

Do I need Notion?

The actual products are Notion templates. You would need a Notion account to duplicate and use them. Any paid Notion features depend on your own plan.

Does a template guarantee certification?

No. A template provides a starting structure. Implementation, evidence, organizational requirements, and an independent certification process remain separate responsibilities.

What happens after demo checkout?

You receive a sample setup guide downloaded in your browser. There is no email delivery, payment processing, or connection to the private template pages.
